tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Food Labelling & Marketing

questions.question: Q: What must a product contain to be labelled 'low fat'?
questions.correctAnswer: No more than 3g of fat per 100g of the product.
questions.explanation: Answer: No more than 3g of fat per 100g of the product.

questions.question: Q: What seven nutrients must be shown on nutritional information labels?
questions.correctAnswer: Energy (kJ/kcal), fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugars, protein, and salt.
questions.explanation: Answer: Energy (kJ/kcal), fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugars, protein, and salt.
